Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the invite. Quick heads up: our Procurement & IT Security teams require completion of the vendor portal intake and a signed NDA before any external demos that include product connectivity or data flows. We also have a short SDL questionnaire that must be returned for a first-pass security review.

I’ve attached the Clinivex_Vendor_Questionnaire_v2.pdf and a DocuSign link for the standard NDA (NDA_DocuSign_Link.txt). Our vendor portal registration is here: https://vendor-portal.clinivex.com/registration/abc123 — Priya from Procurement (cc’d) will validate vendor status.

Procurement indicated that until the portal is accepted, they’ll not clear demo sessions for technical teams. If you can return the questionnaire and route the NDA, Procurement can aim to complete intake by the end of next week, but it could slip if follow-ups are needed.

Apologies for the extra step — it’s mandatory for any vendor that will touch customer data or integrate with our SSO. Happy to coordinate with your security team if that helps.

Best,
Samir
Director, IT Procurement | Clinivex
samir.patel@clinivex.com
+1 (617) 555-0987

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks for the checklist and the heads up. We’ll prioritize the questionnaire and sign the NDA today. I’m looping in our security lead (Mina) and our SE (Priyom) so they can handle any clarifying questions directly.

Given Procurement’s gating requirement, would you be ok if we tentatively move the demo from Apr 22 to a slot the week of May 10 so there’s time to complete intake? Priyom — can you tentatively hold May 12 or 13 (10:00 AM ET) for a demo?

We’ll track the vendor portal status and confirm as soon as we have a green light from Priya. If Redwood can pre-fill any intake fields to speed review, Mina/SE team can send the details over.

Thanks —
Lauren

I reviewed the Clinivex questionnaire. We can expedite our responses and pre-populate the intake form to reduce back-and-forth, but Procurement will still need the DocuSign NDA executed and a couple of technical artifacts from our side:

- SSO metadata (SAML IdP metadata) or details for OIDC issuer
- Data retention policy summary and log retention details
- A contact for security follow-up (I’ll be that contact)

I’m attaching our redwood_vendor_intake_template.xlsx so the team can drop answers into the Clinivex format — if Priyom/Connor can provide the SSO metadata and a short operations FAQ we’ll get the questionnaire into their portal today.

One more note: Connor will be travelling for client on-site work Apr 22–24 and again May 3–5, so that Apr 22 slot won’t work for the demo regardless of intake status. If we’re aiming for the week of May 10, May 12 or 13 still look best on our side.
